_schema_note: Mirrors the LE10 convergence_study schema 1.2.0: per-rung records carry an honest `within_case_tolerance` flag, NOT a per-rung verdict. The single case-level PASS verdict lives ONLY in cross_check_verdict.yaml (the canonical finest 5632-element solve, residual +0.38%).
_trend_monotone_note: trend_monotone refers to the stress MAGNITUDE |sigma_zz@A| (monotonically increasing with refinement). The SIGNED residual is NOT monotone: it changes sign as the magnitude crosses the target, so |residual| is down-then-up (2.39 -> 0.51 -> 0.11 -> 0.38).
notes: NAFEMS LE11 sigma_zz at point A (1.0, 0, 0), inner-radius base corner, vs the published -105 MPa. Real ccx 2.23, full-integration C3D20, quarter solid-of-revolution (pi/2 about z), imposed temperature field T=sqrt(x^2+y^2)+z. The stress MAGNITUDE converges monotonically on the refined branch (88 -> 5632 elements): sigma_zz@A goes -102.49 -> -104.47 -> -105.12 -> -105.40 MPa. It CROSSES the -105 MPa target between the 704- and 2376-element rungs (|104.47| < 105 < |105.12|), so the signed residual changes sign (-2.39% -> -0.51% -> +0.11% -> +0.38%) and |residual| is NOT monotone. The mesh ladder uses a single integer refine factor r scaling all transfinite divisions + revolution layers (r=1..4); Richardson extrapolation is not reported (the corner-stress branch is still mildly climbing at r=4, consistent with a re-entrant inner-radius base corner). The finest 5632-element rung (+0.38%) is pinned canonical (converged value, not the +0.11% 2376-element rung nearest target). Point A landed on node 2 = (1.0,0,0) at every rung.
